Ruling: representation and scope; same reply and project as the earlier rulings. i8949 p. 8, code B: "Correct the error by entering an adjustment in column (g)"; i8949 p. 10, code W. The reply adds boxes G and J (refused with every digital-asset box by sales.digital at sales.one), a sales.route detail condition (a Schedule D aggregate transaction with any code is refused by sales.bad_aggregate, so the condition changes no supported return) and its own refusals for other codes and adjusted aggregates. executable-triage-v2 (.transcription/triage/2025/sales.json, pass 8c6004669339; 1,767 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 466 partial records): 1,698 of 1,833 agree; 9 candidate-refuses, 120 candidate-unknown, 6 project-unknown, all on refused or incomplete returns; no completed return differs. This round changed only the wording of sales.wash_loss (stock received as pay, a bonus award), not an expression. Project stands.

Ruling: representation and model error; i8949 p. 11, column (h). The value is the project's ((d) less (e) plus (g)); the reply shows the line only on the detail route, but the transaction's column (h) amount is read on both routes (sd.line1a.h and sd.line8a.h for the aggregate route), and the project's sheet is a values sheet, so the display condition changes no value.
